title: Pret unveils new £13 salads as office lunch battle heats up
description: The chains says the new range is "priced competitively within the market for this type of lunchtime offer".
content:
Pret A Manger has launched a new range of "premium" salads costing up to £13, which the company says have been "priced competitively".
